extracted.name: Mulled orange wine
extracted.description: Toast Christmas with this warming mulled orange wine, filled with festive fruit and spices. Perfect on cold winter nights, serve in mugs or heatproof glasses
ingredient_lines: 1 orange sliced or cut into wedges
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a simmer over a medium heat.
Reduce the heat and continue to simmer for 10-15 mins until the wine is infused with the spices. Serve in mugs or heatproof glasses.
